issues.description: The solution implementation declares private fields using snake_case (lecture_name, number_of_inscribed_students, etc.) but the constructor and all methods use camelCase identifiers (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, ...). The problem statement / UML also specifies camelCase names. This identifier mismatch causes the solution class to be inconsistent and non-compiling, and it will confuse students who compare the UML, the template, and the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifiers consistent. Rename the private fields in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to use camelCase names matching the UML and constructor/method usage (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors), or alternatively change the constructor/methods to use the snake_case field names. Prefer matching the UML (camelCase) to avoid confusion.
